backend.kind: Actual Python/Flask services and temporary storage with controlled AI and export replies; real local Blender synthetic light-direction renders and saved-scene verification included

frontend.kind: Actual HTML and app JavaScript in jsdom with controlled APIs; no browser pixel or animation acceptance test

static_checks.kind: HTML references, ARIA reference integrity, JavaScript syntax and CSS parsing; no pixel/browser accessibility audit
static_checks.preservationExampleInPlaceholder: 例如：反光柔和一点，颜色和角度不变

notes: Native download links select the latest actual output of the active shot independently of the comparison image. Completed native exports must match the exact snapshot and available source hash; conversion ZIPs never become native .c4d links.

New output records contain a source .blend SHA-256. Export submission checks optional client source URLs and digest and the recorded output digest before queueing, and upgrades legacy cached source URLs only after matching the actual fingerprint.
Existing native files are downloadable independently of conversion runtime readiness. Missing native outputs cannot be reused solely because an old scene ZIP exists.

Render activity uses existing job/material state and real sample/group progress; no elapsed-time percentage or additional model calls. Disconnection stops animations, terminal/project/shot transitions clear stale state, and reduced-motion CSS disables animation.
The planning schema and manual UI expose six optional per-shot key/fill/rim azimuth/elevation values. Unknown old angles are not invented as 0 or 1; blank inputs inherit original or project lighting.
Read-only local Blender inspection supplies actual lamp directions and available roles. File source identity and SHA guards reject stale scene evidence before committing.

The real render adapter uses the existing installed worker, sets only identified requested lights around the actual target, and requires rendered PNG plus reopened .blend agreement. Synthetic worker tests prove the adapter contract, not compatibility with the unavailable user worker.
Light orientation is distinct from camera pose. Direction preservation only locks directions; explicit requested light directions cannot be replaced by power changes.

LLM prompts prefer visible, context-dependent light changes; explicit values and subtle requests take priority. Small-response correction for explicit visible-change complaints remains within the existing two-call ceiling, with independent partial recovery retained.
V10 automatic partial execution, V11 semantic interpretation and preservation, idempotent replay, undo and source guards remain. GPT-5.5 remains blocked and no automatic model upgrade was introduced.
Two original missing-fixture errors remain errors, not passes. No actual cabinet quality, online model success, native Cinema 4D conversion or browser visual acceptance is claimed.
